record: full run of the blocks in docs/verifying-npm-packages.md, every attested version plus the controls
invocation: bash scripts/verify-npm-packages-doc.sh docs/verifying-npm-packages.md <out> all (SHELL_UNDER_TEST=zsh for the zsh run), with npm's update notice turned off

cellKey.G1: latest version, block as written: exit 0, and the output is exactly <package>@<version> then Verified OK
cellKey.G2: every published version from the first attested one, prereleases included, version variable set: exit 0, and the output is exactly <package>@<version> then Verified OK
cellKey.T: one byte appended to the packed tarball by an npm shim: non-zero with the digest error
cellKey.I: identity changed by one token (the repository): non-zero with the identity error
cellKey.C: another genuine tarball and bundle served under the requested name: non-zero with the tarball check message
cellKey.V: an injected version string (regexp block only): non-zero with the version check message
cellKey.U: a version from before provenance began: non-zero with the curl error; cosign never runs
cellKey.N: a version that does not exist (0.0.0): non-zero with npm's code ETARGET
cellKey.S: the attestation listing with its SLSA v1 entry removed by a curl shim: non-zero with the attestation check message
cellKey.Y: the predicate type changed by one token (slsaprovenance1 to spdxjson): non-zero with cosign's invalid predicate type
cellKey.X: one character of the SLSA v1 envelope signature flipped by a curl shim: non-zero with cosign's log inclusion error
cellKey.W: the SLSA v1 bundle's log entries removed by a curl shim: non-zero with cosign's log inclusion error
cellKey.F1: a version value carrying a newline and Verified OK: non-zero with the version check message, no Verified OK line
cellKey.F2: a version value carrying an escape sequence and a carriage return: non-zero with the version check message, no escape byte

ciRunNote: local run on macOS; the CI workflow records Linux bash and macOS zsh runs once it lands
